 PROFILE SUMMARY 
  
 Enterprise DevOps and Platform Architect with over 14 years of experience in shaping 
cloud-native, database -centric platforms and governing end -to-end delivery for 
highly available, production-critical systems. 
 Deep specialization in multi-cloud architecture and large -scale cloud migrations , 
delivering resilient platforms across AWS, Microsoft Azure, IBM Cloud, and GCP with 
strong emphasis on operational stability and scalability. 
 Architect of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and Kubernetes -based platforms , 
enabling standardized, automated, and repeatable deployments across complex 
enterprise environments. 
 Strong engineeri ng focus on production reliability, observability, and incident 
governance, integrating monitoring, automation, and ITSM practices to support 
always-on systems. 
 Technical leader driving platform modernization and DevOps transformation , 
aligning engineering  execution with product and cloud strategy while maintaining 
hands-on involvement in automation and tooling.

IBM | Jul 2021 – Present

 Led and managed DB2W engineering teams , providing technical direction and 
aligning delivery with Product Management and platform roadmaps.  
 Architected and delivered multi-cloud DB2W solutions  on IBM Cloud, AWS, and 
Microsoft Azure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and operational stability.  
 Drove on-premises to cloud migrations  for database platforms, managing design, 
execution, and production readiness. 
 Established Infrastructure as Code standards using ARM, JSON, YAML, and Ansible , 
enabling consistent and automated environment provisioning. 
 Designed & governed Kubernetes platforms  supporting database and cloud -native 
workloads. 
 Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines  using Jenkins and IBM UrbanCode Deploy , 
automating deployments, upgrades, and rollbacks through Ansible Playbooks. 
 Implemented monitoring and observability  using CloudWatch, Azure Application 
Insights, AppDynamics, Grafana, Prometheus, and Sysdig. 
 Managed incident management and production support via ServiceNow, including 
root cause analysis and corrective actions. 
 Delivered hands -on automation and tooling  using Python and Go , and maintain 
technical documentation using Git, Markdown, and SharePoint.
